Metadata.InquiriesOrToReportAnIssue: Inquiries can be made via www.dermgpt.com [SOURCE 3]
Metadata.GlobalAvailability: Yes, it is globally available to dermatologists [SOURCE 3]
Metadata.Summary: DermGPT is an AI chatbot designed to streamline clinical tasks, improve access to dermatologic data, and save time for physicians. It is built on over 3,000 peer-reviewed articles and allows dermatologists to ask questions in natural language and receive relevant, helpful answers. [SOURCE 3, 4]
Metadata.Keywords: AI; chatbot; dermatology; clinical efficiency; peer-reviewed medical journals; prior authorization; patient education

UsesAndDirections.IntendedUseAndWorkflow: DermGPT is intended to assist dermatologists and their staff in everyday practice by providing quick access to dermatology information, answering clinical queries, looking up data, answering patient questions, and accessing handouts. It can also be used to look up diagnoses, treatments, and prior authorization criteria, as well as for patient management and shared decision-making tools. [SOURCE 4]
UsesAndDirections.PrimaryIntendedUsers: Dermatologists, RNs, MAs, and ancillary staff [SOURCE 4]
UsesAndDirections.HowToUse: Dermatologists can sign up at www.dermgpt.com to use the chatbot clinically. It is designed with an intuitive and user-friendly interface. [SOURCE 3, 4]

Warnings.DeveloperSuppliedWarnings: DermGPT should not be used as a stand-alone decision maker, but as an assistant. It does not replace medical care or decision-making. [SOURCE 4]
Warnings.ModelLimitations: DermGPT lacks human creativity, intuition, and the ability to think outside the box. It is most powerful when paired with a dermatology provider or staff who can complement its skills with their higher-level creative problem-solving [SOURCE 4].

TrustIngredients.AISystemFacts: DermGPT is an AI chatbot built on over 3,000 peer-reviewed articles, designed to streamline clinical tasks, improve access to dermatologic data, and save time for physicians [SOURCE 3, 4]. It's trained with chat, reasoning, writing abilities, and customized with a dermatology-specific database [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.ModelType: AI-powered dermatology chatbot utilizing a large language model [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.InteractionWithOtherSystems: DermGPT can integrate with existing EHR systems to streamline documentation and facilitate seamless information exchange [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.OutcomesAndOutput: DermGPT provides relevant, helpful answers to dermatologists' questions, access to dermatology information, patient education handouts, prescription programs, and answers to patient inquiries [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.TypeAndValueOfSolutionOutput: DermGPT can be used for medication options, dosing, interactions, diagnosis summaries, treatment guidelines, appropriate labs, imaging, procedures, visit notes, orders, prescriptions, insurance authorization letters, patient handouts, and study guides for Board Exams [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.ExplanationForHowAnOutputIsGenerated: DermGPT pulls information from a proprietary database of trusted, physician-approved sources and peer-reviewed medical journals [SOURCE 4]. It provides specific and reliable answers by drawing from its curated data [SOURCE 3].
TrustIngredients.InputDataSource: The input data source is a proprietary database sourced from trusted, physician-approved sources and peer-reviewed medical journals [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.OutputInputDataType: Natural language questions and dermatology information including diagnoses, treatments, and prior authorization criteria [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.DevelopmentDataCharacterization: The model is built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles [SOURCE 3].
TrustIngredients.TrainingData: The training data consists of more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles specific to dermatology [SOURCE 3].
TrustIngredients.OngoingMaintenance: The DermGPT platform is continuously updated and improved. [SOURCE 4]
TrustIngredients.TransparencyInformation: DermGPT is built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles, providing specific and reliable information. [SOURCE 3, 4] It avoids using general internet data to minimize errors and hallucinations. [SOURCE 3]

UsefulnessEfficacy.GoalOfMetrics: DermGPT aims to improve patient care and streamline dermatology practices by assisting with increasing clinical tasks and making dermatology information readily available [SOURCE 4]. It serves as an assistant to help save time and improve access to dermatologic data for dermatologists and staff [SOURCE 4].
UsefulnessEfficacy.Interpretation: DermGPT can lead to more efficient patient care, decreased wait times to see a dermatologist, and less physician burnout by saving minutes in a day [SOURCE 4].

Resources.PeerReviewedPublications: DermGPT is built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles [SOURCE 3].
Resources.StakeholdersConsultedDuringDesignOfSolut: The podcast "The Future of Dermatology" features interviews with dermatologists, medical students, and industry professionals [SOURCE 1].
